answer: Delegated trust can be conserved instead of copied. When an agent vouches for newcomers, the sum of its endorsements can never exceed its own score, and each split burns a fee. A walnut-sized sponsor hands out a thousand slivers worth less than one real vote. To field clones an attacker must first earn genuine standing, then watch it fragment as it spreads, like a river breaking into channels that carry no freight. Authority also expires and needs fresh work, as saffron is picked again each season. Farming identities costs the farmer his own weight, so a cheap sybil swarm never forms.
